records.requirement: Goal Tracking OS must track the mission-level entities named by the objective.
records.proof: Structured records exist for goals, projects, milestones, tasks, blockers, decisions, evidence, completed work, deferred work, follow-up actions, objective coverage, and performed daily, weekly, and monthly reviews.
records.gap: Routed app integration and live repository intelligence remain incomplete.
records.next_action: Keep structured records current and add live/static integration only after repository hygiene is isolated.

records.requirement: Goal hierarchy and goal object fields must be defined and machine-checkable.
records.proof: The goal schema and validator enforce required goal fields, statuses, priorities, risks, blockers, evidence links, and next actions.
records.gap: This is a local fixture contract, not a persisted app database.
records.next_action: Keep the lightweight contract stable before adding storage or live adapters.

records.requirement: All strategic categories must have current status, evidence, blockers, and next action.
records.proof: The registry validates 20 goals across the required 20 strategic categories and the generated view exposes category status.
records.gap: Several categories are correctly planned or blocked because implementation evidence is not present.
records.next_action: Do not promote planned or blocked categories until evidence changes.

records.requirement: Goal Tracking Center should show goal, blocker, evidence, readiness, progress, and next-action state without exaggeration.
records.proof: The generated view and static page expose cards, active goals, blocked items, next actions, validation, review cadence, performed reviews, planning, progress, objective coverage, readiness, and guardrails without fake progress bars.
records.gap: The page is not a routed Command Center application module and has no live GitHub, release, public-readiness, or SSH integration.
records.next_action: Promote the generated static contract into the Command Center shell after repository hygiene recovery.

records.requirement: Required Goal Tracking deliverables must exist and remain discoverable.
records.proof: The required deliverables exist, are linked from the docs index, and are included in the Goal Tracking validator.
records.gap: Docs prove the foundation and navigation, not the full application runtime.
records.next_action: Keep the docs index current when adding new Goal Tracking records.

records.requirement: Evidence rules must prevent fake progress, fake completion, fake validation, private data, and unsupported claims.
records.proof: Evidence records include limitations, relative paths, supported goal ids, safe text checks, and scoped sensitive-pattern validation.
records.gap: A full repository secret-history scan and public-readiness review remain unperformed.
records.next_action: Run broader security/public-readiness checks only after repository hygiene is resolved.

records.requirement: Daily, weekly, and monthly review cadence must exist, and performed reviews must not be faked.
records.proof: Cadence definitions exist for daily, weekly, and monthly reviews, and actual daily, weekly, and monthly review logs are recorded with evidence.
records.gap: Future recurring review logs still require current-period evidence.
records.next_action: Keep recurring cadence evidence-backed and do not treat templates as performed reviews.

records.requirement: First implementation priorities must connect goals to evidence, roadmap, backlog, PR queue, and Command Center.
records.proof: Goals are connected to evidence, roadmap items, backlog, next PR queue, generated view data, and static Command Center surface.
records.gap: The routed Command Center shell and repository hygiene recovery remain unfinished.
records.next_action: Resolve repository hygiene blockers before claiming foundation readiness or opening a merge PR.
